gameHelpBody:
Here's a list of all the available commands:
 /CHAT -rec1-rec2-... message : send a message to one or more players
 /BOARD nickname x, y : get a view of the specified player's currently placed cards, centered on the x and y coordinates. Coordinates are optional. 
 /HAND nickname : get a view of the specified player's hand
 /SYMBOLS : show game symbols and their meaning
 /OBJECTIVES : show the objectives you possess
setupHelpBody:
Here's a list of all the available commands:
 /GETRULES open the game's rulebook in your default browser
 /ABOUT show the game's credits
